text:
Charleston Southern men's basketball receives NABC academic excellence awards
The National Association of Basketball Coaches announced on July 15 the recipients of the 2025-26 NABC Team Academic Excellence Awards and NABC Honors Court, which recognize academic achievement by men's college basketball teams and individual student-athletes.
Charleston Southern University was recognized for its academic performance during the 2025-26 school year. Eight members of last season's squad were named to the NABC Honors Court.
The NABC Team Academic Excellence Awards are given to programs that complete the academic year with a team grade point average of 3.0 or higher. The Honors Court recognizes junior, senior, and graduate student men's basketball players who finish the year with a cumulative GPA of at least 3.2.
According to Craig Robinson, executive director of the National Association of Basketball Coaches, "College basketball student-athletes do incredible things on the court, but their achievements in the classroom are equally worthy of celebration. Education is one of the NABC's core values, and the hundreds of programs and thousands of athletes represented on these awards reinforce the commitment to academic success that exists across all levels of our sport."
The eight Charleston Southern players who earned Honors Court recognition are Nate Brafford, Trent Coleman, Jesse Hafemeister, Reis Jones, Kaleb Lofton, Lase Olalere, A'lahn Sumler, and Luke Williams.
